title: Snapchat removes wholly AI-generated videos from Spotlight recommendations
friendlyTitle: Snapchat will not recommend videos made entirely by AI
summary: Snap says wholly AI-generated videos are no longer eligible for recommendation on Spotlight as it shifts discovery toward human-made work. AI-assisted edits made with Snapchat tools can remain eligible when accompanied by transparency indicators.
friendlySummary: Spotlight will favour videos made by people. Creators can still use Snapchat’s AI tools to edit their work if the content includes clear information about that use.
whyItMatters: For creators, the practical distinction is moving from whether AI was used to whether a person made the underlying work and used AI as an editing aid. Detection will be imperfect, but the policy changes the incentive from generating volume toward adding an identifiable human contribution.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People who post videos now have a stronger reason to make original work instead of uploading large amounts of automatic content. Snapchat admits that its detection system will not always be right.
